name: io.github.2nd1st/open-mcp-apps
description: Persistent, interactive MCP Apps — the AI builds an app once, you both reuse it

environmentVariables.name: OMA_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite store. Defaults to a fixed per-user data directory; set this to isolate a store.

environmentVariables.name: OMA_VIEWER
environmentVariables.description: Browser viewer on loopback. On by default; set to 0 to turn it off.

environmentVariables.name: OMA_DYNAMIC_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to also expose one open_<name> tool per saved app. Off by default, because it costs prompt cache.
